proof_body:
by
  intro a b r a' b' r' hr hr' h
  have h₁ := (h (a + r) b).mp (by ring)
  have h₂ := (h (a - r) b).mp (by ring)
  have h₃ := (h a (b + r)).mp (by ring)
  have h₄ := (h a (b - r)).mp (by ring)
  have ea : r * (a - a') = 0 := by linear_combination (h₁ - h₂) / 4
  have eb : r * (b - b') = 0 := by linear_combination (h₃ - h₄) / 4
  have ea' : a = a' := by
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp ea).resolve_left hr.ne'
    linarith
  have eb' : b = b' := by
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp eb).resolve_left hr.ne'
    linarith
  subst ea' eb'
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  have : r ^ 2 = r' ^ 2 := by linear_combination h₁
  exact (pow_left_inj₀ hr.le hr'.le two_ne_zero).mp this
